dct_creator_sm: Prince Edward Island Government Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm:
A polygon-based geospatial dataset representing the community zones used for organizing and 
managing civic addressing across Prince Edward Island. These zones define logical geographic areas that 
group civic addresses for planning, emergency response, service delivery, and administrative purposes.

Each row represents a single community zone boundary used in the provincial civic addressing system.
